canonical_data: service-managed Context Graph and Context Lake with episodes, entities, relationships, provenance, permissions, and temporal validity
current_repo_note: Zep Cloud is the proprietary managed memory service; the separately reviewed Graphiti record covers its reusable open-source temporal graph engine.
strengths: Temporal context graph models changing facts and relationship history rather than flattening all memories
Managed APIs, SDKs, dashboard, and governance reduce the operational burden of Graphiti-style memory
Episode and temporal provenance support explainable context assembly for long-lived agents
weaknesses: Proprietary managed service with no equivalent self-hosted deployment boundary
Canonical memory is service-managed rather than human-readable or directly editable
Terms and subprocessor choices require close review for sensitive long-term agent context
why_it_matters: Separates the managed agent-memory product from Graphiti and provides a reference for governed enterprise context graphs as a service.
